title: Sanjay Singh Raises UP Employment Concerns over Recruitment Issues
excerpt: AAP Rajya Sabha MP Sanjay Singh has highlighted employment and recruitment concerns in Uttar Pradesh, questioning national job creation figures.
meta_description: AAP MP Sanjay Singh addresses Uttar Pradesh unemployment and recruitment concerns, questioning central job creation promises during a public programme.
content:
Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Rajya Sabha Member of Parliament Sanjay Singh has raised serious concerns regarding unemployment and recruitment issues in Uttar Pradesh. The remarks were made during a public programme held in Ghorawal, Sonbhadra.

Recruitment and Jobseeker Concerns in Uttar Pradesh

According to the details shared by AAP Uttar Pradesh, Singh addressed various recruitment sectors in the state. He pointed to vacancies and selection processes concerning police constables, clerks, teachers, lekhpals, engineering positions, medical services, and the Provincial Civil Service Judicial (PCS-J) examinations, alleging that young jobseekers in the state have been let down by current administrative approaches.

Questions on National Employment Promises

During his address, the AAP leader also referred to earlier national employment targets. He questioned the Prime Minister's previously stated commitment of generating two crore jobs annually. Singh argued that calculating this figure cumulatively over a twelve-year span would theoretically result in twenty-four crore jobs.
